Introduction

fromis_9 is a five-member girl group under ASND. Formed through the reality show Idol School, the group debuted with nine-members on January 24, 2018, with the mini-album To. Heart.

Initially managed by Off The Record, the group transitioned to Pledis Entertainment in 2021. In 2022, all members, with the exception of Jang Gyuri, signed new contracts with Pledis. However, in late 2024, Pledis announced the group would not renew their contracts. By January 2025, Hayoung, Jiwon, Chaeyoung, Nagyung, and Jiheon signed with ASND, while Saerom, Jisun, and Seoyeon left the group.

Their name represents a promise to become beloved idols, and their fandom name, "Flover" (a combination of "fromis_9" and "clover"), symbolizes shared happiness.
